name: Autopilot Shorts Pipeline (n8n + Ollama + Kokoro + Whisper + FFmpeg)

options.systemMessage:
You are an expert viral tech scriptwriter. Return ONLY a raw JSON object with NO markdown code blocks, no backticks, and no extra text. Use the exact following structure:
{
  "video_title": "String",
  "hook": "Spoken line under 3 seconds",
  "script_body": "Fast-paced spoken content, max 65 words, no emojis",
  "visual_prompts": ["Prompt for visual scene 1", "Prompt for visual scene 2", "Prompt for visual scene 3"],
  "pinned_comment_call_to_action": "Affiliate call to action link text"
}

parameters.command:
=mkdir C:
8n-shorts 2>nul & cd /d C:
8n-shorts && powershell -NoProfile -Command "$e=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false); [IO.File]::WriteAllText('C:
8n-shorts\script.txt',$e.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('{{ $json.voiceover_b64 }}')),$e); [IO.File]::WriteAllText('C:
8n-shorts\video_data.json',$e.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String('{{ $json.data_b64 }}')),$e)" && set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8&& kokoro-tts script.txt voiceover.mp3 --voice am_adam --speed 1.15 --format mp3

=cd /d C:\n8n-shorts && (python -u make_short.py > render.log 2>&1) && (if not exist videos mkdir videos) && (if not exist "%USERPROFILE%\.n8n-files" mkdir "%USERPROFILE%\.n8n-files") && copy /y final_short.mp4 "%USERPROFILE%\.n8n-files\final_short.mp4" >nul && cd videos && copy /y ..\final_short.mp4 "{{ $('Parse Script JSON').item.json.run_id }}.mp4" >nul && cd .. && type render.log

assignments.name: topic
assignments.value: a crazy AI tool or local automation workflow that saves people 10 hours a week

parameters.command: cd /d C:\n8n-shorts && set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8&& python -u fetch_broll.py --min 15 2>&1
